name: catalyst_center_api_call
description: Call the Cisco Catalyst Center (DNA Center) REST API. Pass the FULL path from the host root. Auth (Basic -> token -> X-Auth-Token header) is handled for you; do NOT call the auth/token endpoint. Returns {status_code, data, error, blast_radius}; list rows are under data['response']. Bases: /dna/intent/api/v1 (most resources), /dna/intent/api/v2, /dna/system/api/v1. Key endpoints: GET /dna/intent/api/v1/network-device (devices), /network-device/count, /network-device/{id} (detail), /site (sites), /topology/physical-topology, /network-health, /client-health, /template-programmer/template, POST /network-device-poller/cli/read-request (read-only CLI, async -> taskId), GET /task/{taskId} (poll). Page with query_params {'offset':1,'limit':500}. Check status_code < 400 before trusting data.
